Title: Valid admin login redirects to dashboard
Preconditions: DB reset to seed state; user on /login
Steps: 1. Enter admin email 2. Enter password 3. Click Sign in
Expected Result: User is redirected to /admin/dashboard and dashboard cards are visible

Title: Valid technician login redirects to /tech/jobs
Preconditions: DB reset to seed state; user on /login
Steps: 1. Enter technician email 2. Enter password 3. Click Sign in
Expected Result: User is redirected to /tech/jobs and only assigned jobs are shown

Title: Invalid credentials show an error and no session is created
Steps: 1. Enter a valid email with a wrong password 2. Click Sign in 3. Navigate directly to /admin/dashboard
Expected Result: Error "Invalid email or password" is shown; user stays on /login; visiting a protected page afterwards still redirects to /login

Title: Empty email/password shows a validation message
Steps: 1. Leave both fields empty 2. Click Sign in
Expected Result: Error "Email and password are required" is shown; no request is sent

Title: Unauthenticated user cannot open a protected page
Steps: 1. Without logging in, navigate directly to /admin/dashboard 2. Navigate directly to /tech/jobs
Expected Result: Both attempts redirect to /login

Title: Technician cannot access Admin pages
Steps: 1. Navigate directly to /admin/dashboard 2. Navigate directly to /admin/customers
Expected Result: Both attempts redirect back to /tech/jobs (not /login)

Title: Logout clears the session
Steps: 1. Click Logout 2. Navigate directly to /admin/dashboard
Expected Result: User is redirected to /login both times; the old session cannot be reused

Title: Login API returns a token and admin user
Steps: 1. POST /api/auth/login with valid admin credentials
Expected Result: 200 response; body contains token="mock-token-admin" and user.role="admin"

Title: Login API returns a technicianId for technician accounts
Steps: 1. POST /api/auth/login with valid technician credentials
Expected Result: 200 response; user.role=technician and user.technicianId is present

Title: Login API rejects invalid credentials
Steps: 1. POST /api/auth/login with a wrong password
Expected Result: 401 response with code=INVALID_CREDENTIALS

Title: Login API rejects a missing password
Steps: 1. POST /api/auth/login with password omitted
Expected Result: 400 response

Title: Health endpoint is reachable without authentication
Steps: 1. GET /api/health with no Authorization header
Expected Result: 200 response

Title: Job creation rejects 6 units (max is 5)

Title: Job creation rejects an unknown customer
Steps: 1. POST /api/jobs with a customerId that does not exist

Title: Job creation rejects an unknown technician

Expected Result: 404 response

Title: Full booking-to-paid-invoice loop across both roles
Steps: 1. Admin creates a customer 2. Admin creates a Pending job for that customer 3. Admin assigns a technician 4. Technician logs in and starts the job 5. Technician records a used part 6. Technician completes the job 7. Admin opens the job and its generated invoice 8. Admin marks the invoice Paid 9. Admin checks the dashboard
Test Data: serviceType=Cleaning; units=1; priority=Normal; part=Air Filter x1
Expected Result: Job ends Completed; invoice totals match pricing rules (service 600 + parts 150, VAT 7 percent, total 802.50); invoice ends Paid with a receipt number; dashboard's Completed count increases by 1
